ev.q: This report describes two related cases of CO poisoning that occurred in children
Nearly 3 hours after exposure, the child's carboxyhemoglobin (COHb) level was 14.3%
Approximately 4 hours after exposure, his COHb level was 10.1%.
Back calculations of COHb levels estimated that her COHb level was 50%--57% immediately after exposure
